values: OWR-12697710-015 (30005468) — Rational certificates for truncated moment nonrepresentability

Research note: p=1+f on the rational three-variable unit ball has minimum 1, annihilates an explicit rational mass-1 degree-4 moment vector, and lies in 1+Q_R(g) but not 1+Q_Q(g), for rational polynomial-square multipliers of arbitrary finite degree. The input moment matrix is not PSD. A different q=1+x^4 works rationally; p itself and each rational rescaling cp, c>1 are rationally positivity-certifiable. Classical quartic/local obstruction and earlier real-ball/Gram/SDP applications credited.
